sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B model card
sources.evidence: Exact post-trained checkpoint; nominal language-model size 0.8B, native 262144-token context, text/image/video input, text responses, thinking and tool examples. Intended for prototyping and task-specific fine-tuning.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; 24 language layers with three linear-attention layers per full-attention layer, dense intermediate_size 3584, tied embeddings, vision encoder, and one MTP layer. No routed-expert configuration.

sources.title: Official Qwen3.5-0.8B safetensors checkpoint header
sources.evidence: Read the 59840-byte JSON tensor header by HTTP range. Sum of shape products across 488 stored tensors is 873438784: model.language_model 752393024, model.visual 100592896, mtp 20452864. Independently matches Hugging Face API tensor total.

sources.title: Official Qwen repository release news
sources.evidence: The Qwen3.5 repository redirects to the maintained Qwen3.8 repository. Its retained news explicitly announces availability of Qwen3.5-0.8B on Hugging Face and ModelScope on 2026-03-02; repository identifies Qwen team, Alibaba Group.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-0.8B LICENSE
sources.evidence: Fetched successfully via direct HTTP after web extraction failed; Apache License Version 2.0.

name.note: Display formatting of official Qwen3.5-0.8B name.

developer.note: Developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba.

release_date.note: Explicit open-weight announcement; earlier repository creation alone does not establish public release.

parameters_b.note: Complete checkpoint tensor count, including vision and MTP; counted from actual tensor shapes, not inferred from file bytes. The card's 0.8B is a nominal language-model label.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-per-token count. Dense FFNs do not justify treating every vision, embedding and MTP parameter as active on each generated token.

architecture.note: Dense FFNs with hybrid Gated DeltaNet linear attention and gated full attention, plus a vision encoder. Family-level MoE marketing does not describe this variant.

context_window.note: max_position_embeddings is 262144; card also calls this native context.

modalities.note: Exact-model input examples and conditional text generation.

reasoning.note: Optional thinking; non-thinking is the default.

tool_call.note: Exact-model Qwen-Agent example defines and invokes tools.

description.value: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling, intended for prototyping and task-specific fine-tuning.
description.note: Replaces the unsupported on-device use-case characterization with the stated intended uses.

patch.description: Dense Qwen3.5 vision-language model with optional thinking and tool calling, intended for prototyping and task-specific fine-tuning.
patch.notes: The official 0.8B label refers to nominal language-model size. The full released checkpoint contains 0.873438784B stored parameters: language model 0.752393024B, vision 0.100592896B, MTP 0.020452864B. Its dense FFNs use hybrid Gated DeltaNet and gated attention. No active-per-token parameter count is separately reported.

summary: Correct full-checkpoint count to 0.873438784B and identify dense hybrid-attention architecture. Keep active parameters null. Confirm March 2 open-weight release, Apache-2.0, native context and capabilities; remove unsupported on-device positioning.
